posts.text:
西欧这个周末又升温了。早早去买了菜，在太阳光最剧烈的时候用电，利用太阳能板薅点太阳的羊毛。
把地板擦干净了，然后安静画画、喝茶。
今天买了一个号称用益生菌清厕所的产品，广告语挺有意思：
If your nature is not cleaning, then let the nature cleans for you!
我琢磨着，能清厕所的益生菌，那岂不就是喜欢吃屎喝尿的益生菌？
而且的确把厕所清得超级白！

You think the quality of your products is the reason your brand can't scale consistently

Meanwhile, we have Temu out here beating the biggest brands - brands like Gymshark

Here's the reality with Google ads:

Having great products is a necessity, but Google's algorithm doesn't know the quality of your products

It understands the quality of your product feed and the perceived value

The only way to feed this algorithm the right data is by increasing the perceived value

We do this by focusing on the end goals of:

- Getting users to spend more time on our landing pages
- Having a higher than normal CTR 

Just two things

Getting these on point takes care of everything else
